rule: Simple geometric objects (ball, orb, bubble, ring, spike, block, gem) must route with visual:"shape", never "creature" or sprite art.
Dynamic ground entities must spawn at y = 400 - h with solid: false and gravityScale: 1 so they never trap or block the player.
Sprite sheets must keep a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background with wide gaps between poses and no ground lines or text.
Weather rain drops must fall with wind-driven slant/angle and spawn a small splash burst effect on ground impact.
note: raindrops should slant slightly with the wind and splash with a small burst on ground impact

rule: Jetpack must require separate input + fuel/cooldown and clamp vertical velocity/altitude; never apply continuous thrust while jump is held.
note: test: jetpack thrust lifts player high while jump held, minY=344

rule: Bind jetpack thrust to held jump input only — never to shoot/fire — and gate thrust with fuel >0 and cooldown checks.
note: test: jetpack thrust on separate shoot input, vy=158.33333333333354 y=203.75000000000006

rule: Never place solid ground-level walls across the run path; make hideout/decorative walls non-solid or leave a player-sized passable gap.
note: playtest: You'd get stuck by the wall and couldn't keep going. (playtest (seed 11): the bot only got 414px right (1560px without this mod), stuck against a "wall" at x=560,y=240,w=24,h=70. Player size 26x34 -> 26x34)
